description:
SharePoint Developer (Need LinkedIn references for the submission) 
 Long term project 
 Sitting in Dallas, TX 
 Need GC and USC 
 Please note, this opening is pure Sharepoint 2013 Development, so I need a candidate that does 100% development, an development/admin candidate won’t work.
 Top Three Skills: 
 1. SharePoint 2013 Development. Not just SharePoint configuration, experience developing web parts WITHOUT using SharePoint Designer or out of the box tools
 2. .C#/Visual Studio. Custom code deployment experience
 3. Experience publishing customer-facing sites. 
 Job Description: 
 Candidate must be a solid .Net/C# developer that has experience doing custom code deployment using SharePoint 2013 as the Content Management System (CMS). This developer will be working on externally facing web sites, physician portals and customization of the EHR. 
 They don't use SharePoint Designer or any other Out of the Box SharePoint development tools to create web parts. Need someone that can create custom web parts using Visual Studio and C#.


 If you are interested please share your resume to Preethib @usmsystems(DOT)com or you can call me directly on 703 468 0398.
